column1: # Cases for ssh-request-guard.sh — one per line: <verdict><TAB><command>
# verdict is `pass` (no output) or `ask` (permissionDecision "ask"). Use \n for a newline inside a
# command; the runner decodes it with printf %b.

column2: ssh node01 'docker exec funds-poller python -c "import radar"'
ssh node01 "cd /opt/funds && docker compose exec funds-poller python x.py"
git commit -F - <<'EOF'\nuse ssh node01 curl to check\nEOF

column1: # ssh options that take a value: the host is found after them, including bundles and after-host options
# wrappers stay covered by the whole-text check

column2: ssh node01 'for u in a b; do curl $u; done'
ssh node01 'docker --context prod exec app python x.py'
ssh node01 'docker container run --rm alpine wget x'
ssh node01 'kubectl -n prod exec pod -- ls'

column1: # a remote shell reading its script from stdin

column2: ssh node01 'cat > /tmp/notes.txt' <<EOF\nremember to curl the thing\nEOF

column1: # tunnels that carry traffic out from the remote host
# only ssh's own arguments count: local commands around it do not

column2: ssh node01 'docker compose ps' && curl -s https://example.com
